(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (grill_free))
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (grill_free))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (at start (stackable bun_bot))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))
  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (grilled chicken)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken))))
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked chicken)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
)

  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    patty14 yam14 lettuce14 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (cut ?i - item) (boiled ?i - item) (mashed ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (grill_free) (cutting_board_free) (boiler_free))
  
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (grill_free))))
  
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (cut ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) (at end (boiled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (boiler_free))))
  
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (boiled ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (mashed ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free))))
  
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))
  
  (:durative-action stack_lettuce14
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable lettuce14)) (at start (cut lettuce14)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable lettuce14))) (at end (stacked lettuce14))))
  
  (:durative-action stack_patty14
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable patty14)) (at start (grilled patty14)) (at start (stacked lettuce14)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable patty14))) (at end (stacked patty14))))
  
  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked patty14)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
  )
